language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hello my name is Justin and I live on the beautiful island of Curacao in the Antilles.
Yesterday, I was teaching my younger cousin Anthony about energy. There are several types of energy such as heat, light, sound, electrical, potential and kinetic energy.
We can observe heat and light energy by looking at the sun. By listening to the radio, we observe sound and electrical energy. Sometimes more than one type of energy is being used at the same time.

Potential energy is energy which is stored within an object. An example of potential energy is the fat in our body. Fat is food stored in our body until we need it. Kinetic energy on the other hand is energy that's within moving objects.
Energy can neither be created nor destroyed but rather it is converted from one form to another. Join us to learn more about the different forms of energy.

There are three types of potential energy: gravitational, elastic and chemical potential energy. As we learned earlier, potential energy is the stored energy which can be used at a later time. It is stored when a body is not in motion. Let's learn a bit more. Can you help me answer these questions?
